name: player_keeptradecut_position_rank year axis carries a 30-day recency floor (executed-result parity)
description: Without a recency floor, the year-axis as-of lookup reaches back unbounded, so a player who was delisted years ago keeps rendering their final rank for every later season -- measured on production 2026-07-31, Tom Brady (last ranked 2021-12-21) was rendered QB23 for the 2025 season. Seed a stale player whose only observation carrying a rank sits 2 years before the 2025 opening-day boundary (well outside the 30-day window) and a fresh player whose only observation sits 5 days before it (inside the window). The stale player's rank must read NULL and the fresh player's must read populated. This fixture fails if the two `lower_bound_sql` lines in the year-axis branch of keeptradecut_join are removed: the stale player's rank then resolves to its 2-year-old value instead of NULL.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2025]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "t81290b65b3ec97c4d5bc327b7e5b7879" as (select distinct on (ktc_src.pid, ktc_od.year) ktc_src.pid, ktc_od.year, ktc_src.position_rank from opening_days ktc_od inner join keeptradecut_valuations ktc_src on ktc_src.is_superflex = true and ktc_src.position_rank is not null and ktc_src.observed_at <= LEAST(date_trunc('day', ktc_od.opening_day) + interval '0 year', now()) and ktc_src.observed_at > (LEAST(date_trunc('day', ktc_od.opening_day) + interval '0 year', now()) - interval '30 days') order by ktc_src.pid, ktc_od.year, ktc_src.observed_at desc) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t73dd9be5b5b4954d409c2145e9f1aa2c"."position_rank" AS "player_keeptradecut_position_rank_0", "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t81290b65b3ec97c4d5bc327b7e5b7879" as "t73dd9be5b5b4954d409c2145e9f1aa2c" on "t73dd9be5b5b4954d409c2145e9f1aa2c"."pid" = "player"."pid" and t73dd9be5b5b4954d409c2145e9f1aa2c.year = (player_years.year) where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t73dd9be5b5b4954d409c2145e9f1aa2c"."position_rank", "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
